circuit.name: 5t-ota
circuit.rationale: GBW=gm1/(2*pi*CL) fell short: pair is in moderate inversion with low gm1. Doubling tail width doubles itail (est. ~35 to ~70uA, under 100uA budget); with wider pair (m=6) gm1 roughly doubles, lifting GBW past 20MHz. Mirror pole gm3 scales with current, preserving phase margin.
